rationale: The agent did not ask the user for confirmation before submitting the return, violating the policy to confirm any order-changing action. It also processed a refund to a gift card, whereas the user’s stated preference (absent a confirmation prompt) was refund to credit card. There is no evidence the agent verified or selected the less expensive tablet as requested. While the agent appeared to authenticate by matching name and ZIP and accessed the user’s orders, the lack of confirmation and mismatch with refund method and requested item selection mean the request was not completed in line with policy.
